simple.meaning: נָהָר (nâhâr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 2:10. The surrounding context includes death, covenant, land, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָהָר (H5104) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: נָהָר (nâhâr) / H5104 is traced through Genesis 2:10, Genesis 2:13, Genesis 2:14, Genesis 15:18 with generated occurrence evidence.
